issues.display_title: Issue #436: Use Authorization Variable in API Collection
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 12/08/26

✅ Implementation: Use Authorization Variable in API Collection

Changes

  • Updated 100 active Authorization request headers to use {{bearerToken}} directly.
  • Removed 102 Authorization entries from saved request examples.
  • Added bearerToken: <YOUR_JWT_TOKEN> to Dev, Live, and Local - Dev environments.
  • Preserved all non-authorization request settings.
  • Did not use Bruno bearer authentication because API expects token without Bearer prefix.

Usage

  1. Select an API collection environment.
  2. Replace <YOUR_JWT_TOKEN> in bearerToken with valid Panorra token.
  3. Send protected request. Header resolves to:
Authorization: <JWT token>

Verification

  • 100 active authorization headers use {{bearerToken}}.
  • Zero authorization headers remain in saved request examples.
  • Zero hardcoded JWT values remain.
  • Each of three environments defines exactly one bearerToken.
  • git diff --check -- "api-collection/Panorra API Post" docs/tasks succeeds.

Scope

  • Replace hardcoded JWT values in active Authorization request headers with {{bearerToken}}.
  • Send token directly without Bearer prefix.
  • Add bearerToken to Dev, Live, and Local - Dev environments.
  • Remove Authorization headers from saved request examples.
  • Keep other headers, request data, and endpoint behavior unchanged.

Request Header

Authorization: {{bearerToken}}

Environment Variable

- name: bearerToken
  value: <YOUR_JWT_TOKEN>

Acceptance Criteria

  • Every active Authorization header uses {{bearerToken}}.
  • No active header adds Bearer prefix.
  • All three environments define bearerToken.
  • Saved request examples contain no Authorization header.
  • No hardcoded JWT remains in api-collection/Panorra API Post.

RESULT 12/08/26

✅ Implementation: Remove Unused Functions

Changes

  • Removed 13 directly unreferenced functions.
  • Removed Encode and Decode, which were reachable only through unused encryption example helpers.
  • Removed unused context and golang.org/x/oauth2 imports.
  • Changed four source files:
    • src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/BroadcastFunctions/BroadcastFunctions.go

git diff --check -- src

Results:

  • Staticcheck unused-function findings: 0.

Notes

  • Results apply to the active Go build configuration.

  • Find Go functions with no reachable caller or source reference.

issues.display_title: Issue #439: Reuse One MinIO Client per Process
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 12/08/26

✅ Implementation: Reuse One MinIO Client per Process

Changes

  • Added package-owned sync.Once, shared client, and cached error state.
  • Kept the existing InitMinioClient() (*minio.Client, error) interface, avoiding changes across approximately 30 call sites.
  • Added explicit validation for:
    • MINIO_ENDPOINT
    • MINIO_ACCESS_KEY
    • MINIO_SECRET_KEY
  • Added fail-fast initialization after environment loading in:
    • cmd/main.go
    • src/Worker/UploadPanorama/UploadPanorama.go
    • src/Worker/PublishPanorraGD360/PublishPanorraGD360.go
  • Added tests for repeated calls, concurrent calls, and cached configuration errors.
  • Added no dependency and changed no MinIO object operation.

Files

  • cmd/main.go
  • src/Utils/Minio/MinioFunctions.go
  • src/Utils/Minio/MinioFunctions_test.go
  • src/Worker/UploadPanorama/UploadPanorama.go
  • src/Worker/PublishPanorraGD360/PublishPanorraGD360.go

Verification

go test ./src/Utils/Minio -count=1
go test ./...
go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@latest ./src/Utils/Minio ./cmd ./src/Worker/UploadPanorama ./src/Worker/PublishPanorraGD360
git diff --check

Results:

  • Focused MinIO tests pass.
  • All repository tests pass.
  • Staticcheck passes for all changed packages.
  • Diff whitespace validation passes.
  • One minio.New constructor remains.

Known Existing Issues

Full-repository staticcheck still reports 10 pre-existing findings outside this task, primarily deprecated io/ioutil, deprecated Google Drive constructors, and an existing identical-expression warning.

The race test could not run because CGO is disabled in the current environment.

Git

  • Branch: refactor/minio-client-singleton
  • No commit or push was performed.

Problem

InitMinioClient creates a new MinIO SDK client on every call. The function is used around 30 times across API handlers and workers, including repeated calls in hot paths.

Scope

  • Preserve InitMinioClient() (*minio.Client, error).
  • Create the underlying MinIO client once per OS process.
  • Make initialization safe for concurrent callers.
  • Return the same client pointer after successful initialization.
  • Cache initialization errors consistently.
  • Validate MINIO_ENDPOINT, MINIO_ACCESS_KEY, and MINIO_SECRET_KEY.
  • Fail fast during startup in the API and MinIO-using workers.
  • Preserve bucket, object, handler, and worker behavior.
  • Add no dependency.
  • Do not commit or push changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Only one minio.New call exists in the repository.
  • Repeated and concurrent calls return the same client pointer.
  • Missing configuration returns a stable cached error.
  • API startup initializes MinIO before serving requests.
  • UploadPanorama and PublishPanorraGD360 initialize MinIO before consuming messages.
  • go test ./... succeeds.
  • Staticcheck succeeds for changed packages.
  • git diff --check succeeds.
